4 · Gallery

Weather × time of day × lap position. Tap an image to enlarge. Shots are TLX on SwiftShader, 960×540; park/chase and race-HUD frames were not captured.

Orbit · day · dry

Baseline. Sky is a saturated generic blue and the verge shows tan ochre bands, neither matching the brief's muted Eifel palette (defects 3, 4).

Orbit · day · wet

Road darkens and gains specular; ghost mirrored pine reflections appear under trees at s 0.17 and 0.83 (defect 6).

Orbit · day · rain

Rain streaks plus darker deck. Same ghost reflections as wet.

Orbit · day · overcast

Sky stays bright saturated blue; only low haze patches appear. Overcast does not read as overcast (defect 3).

Orbit · day · fog

Ground haze patches; sky above stays vivid blue, so the fog reads as low mist blobs, not a fogged day.

Orbit · day · storm

Reads as dark grey daytime (PR #1979 daytime fix works): readable, not night.

Orbit · dusk · dry

Warm light pools on the verge; scenery and horizon fall dark quickly.

Orbit · dusk · rain

Same plus wet road glints and ghost pine reflections.

Orbit · night · dry

No circuit lamps (furniture lamp 'none', night false): only car light pools show; stands, bridge and trees fall to black (defect 5).

Orbit · night · rain

As night dry with wet sheen.

Eye (driver-height free cam) · day dry

Six lap positions.

Trackside · day dry

Free-cam looking in. s 0.00 is a wall of the pit/grandstand blocks the view; s 0.67 shows the open scaffold stand.

5 · Not captured / uncertain

  • Cut from the matrix: eye and trackside only at day dry (not other weathers); dawn not captured; storm only at day; dusk/night only orbit; no HUD or driving-camera frames.
  • Burg Nürburg is not identifiable in the aerial #80 (castle height and cone may sit hidden behind the rock ring); no close-up. Treat its placement as unverified.
  • Frame labels use the nominal lap fraction passed to the shot tool; free-cam frames at s .00 can sit in front of a wall.
  • Default time-of-day (no --tod override) palette not captured; defect 3 describes the explicit-day branch used by every day frame here.
  • Real-world accuracy (corner names, Veedol/Coca-Cola positions) was not checked against external sources; the brief's lap fractions disagree with built geometry (defects 1, 2) and the real layout may differ from both.
  • graph-parity and driving-line audits were not run.
